newsitem.title: GERMANY: EU 1996/97 olive oil output 1.58 mln T - Oil World.
newsitem.headline: EU 1996/97 olive oil output 1.58 mln T - Oil World.

text.p: The European Union should produce 1.58 million tonnes of olive oil in the 1996/97 season, including pressed and residue oils, independent newsletter Oil World said on Tuesday.

Although this was down from Oil World's earlier forecast of 1.66 million, it would still be well above the 1.30 million tonnes produced in the EU in 95/96 and the 1.45 million tonne average recorded in the previous five seasons up to 94/95.
Oil World cited weather damage to the leading Spanish crop.
Rain and storm in Andalucia, the region accounting for 80 percent of total Spanish olive output, had damaged parts of the crop still left in the fields, it said.
December floods had damaged olive crops across the south of Spain.
Spain's 96/97 pressed olive oil output would fall short of the previously anticipated 650,000 tonnes and was unlikely to exceed the previous record crop in 92/93 of 624,000 tonnes.
But it would still be sharply higher than the 322,000 tonnes produced in 95/96.
